==================
Keyboard Shortcuts
==================

**Note:** Keyboard shortcuts are not currently implemented in IFU Analyzer.

Current Interface
=================

IFU Analyzer currently uses a button-based interface. All functions are accessible through:

- **Toolbar Buttons**: Click buttons in the toolbar at the top
- **Right-Click Context Menus**: Right-click on the intensity map or spectrum for options
- **Dialog Buttons**: Click buttons within dialog windows for actions

Navigation
==========

**Wavelength Navigation**

Use the wavelength slider on the left control panel to move through the data cube:

- Click and drag to navigate continuously
- Click on specific values to jump to that wavelength
- Use arrow buttons if available next to the slider

**Zoom and Pan**

- **Scroll Wheel**: Zoom in and out on the intensity map
- **Toolbar Buttons**: Use zoom and pan buttons in the main toolbar

**Intensity Adjustment**

Use vmin/vmax sliders to adjust the displayed intensity range (brightness/contrast).

Right-Click Menus
=================

**On Intensity Map**

- View statistics
- Clear selection
- Other region options

**On Spectrum**

- Export spectrum
- View fit results
- Zoom spectral region

Future Features
===============

Keyboard shortcut support may be added in future versions of IFU Analyzer. Currently, all functionality is accessible through the button interface.
